The 2004 British Grand Prix, held at Silverstone on 11 July 2004 (round 11), was won by Michael Schumacher of Ferrari. He started from 4th on the grid. Kimi Räikkönen (McLaren) finished second and Rubens Barrichello (Ferrari) third.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
